dedupe_keys.name: traffic signal network device status log

description: Traffic Signal Network Device Status Log is a dataset listed in City of Austin open data portal (datahub.austintexas.gov), an open data portal (Socrata) of a city, published or maintained by City of Austin. Austin Transportation & Public Works manages thousands of IP-enabled devices which enable traffic signal operations. Devices include traffic cameras, battery backup systems, signal controllers, and vehicle detectors. This dataset, updated daily, serves as a log of attempts to communicate with the various various devices on the traffic signals network. Coverage: Austin. The portal files it under the category Transportation and Mobility. Its tags are traffic signals, communications, transportation. The table has 11 columns. Attribution on the portal: City of Austin, Texas - data.austintexas.gov. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last data update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 1.0 Universal (Public Domain Dedication). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-soc-datahub-austintexas-gov-portal.
